notes.title: Before the launch, we would like to say
notes.notes:
Our game content is very small, we suggest that you play the game within 2 hours, so that you can determine whether it is worth buying our game, and have the opportunity to apply for a refund.

What we wanted to do was make love games that had numerical nurturing fun.
However, due to the first program, before the game was about to be completed, he wanted to get more remuneration, which caused a conflict with us. He finally quit the team and maliciously deleted many game achievements, threatening us that he would release the game alone with our art achievements.
We had to change the program, move on from the mid-game version, and speed up the release.
That's why we delayed the release in May.

The first program, the rest of it, was so buggy that we had to make a choice:
1. Developed on the basis of the first program, but new bugs may appear every time a new function is added;
2. Completely start development from 0, but it will waste a lot of time;
3. Remove the bugs, but the game experience will be much less.

We decided to use the third option, which would have been terrible for the player but would have kept our team going.

But we shouldn't let players take on our problems.
After we delete the content, the game content can be played within 1 hour.
So we suggest you try the game as soon as possible, and after you play it, decide if our game is worth the price.
At the same time, you can give us a bad review, or apply for a refund, which is your right.

If you do not make a refund, we will use your money to develop a new game, and it will be better!

I'm sorry we can't give you the best.
Thank you for your willingness to support us.

notes.title: Our release date is set to June 8th
notes.notes:
Sorry, we have some bugs in the game content due to technical reasons, so in order to fix the game bugs, we postponed the game release time to June 8th.

Our game has more expanded content, you can find them in the player community after the release.

Thank you for your support and attention to us!
